about.heading: Syed Labeeq Sajid Bukhari
about.tagline: Senior Vulnerability Researcher at Ebryx LLC.
bio: I am a vulnerability researcher focused on turning offensive tradecraft into defenses. Over the past five years I have moved from malware analysis into building automation that scales threat detection across enterprise level.

At Ebryx I lead security research and automation initiatives, guiding cross-functional teams that cover red-team assessments to implementing mitigation. My work spans exploit development, reverse engineering, custom tooling, and integrating OSINT-driven exposure analysis into production pipelines.
Binary Thoughts is where I document the research that shapes our defenses: from kernel-level PoCs and adversary emulation to automation patterns that keep detections sharp long after disclosure day.

focus.definition: Designing pipelines that convert exploit research into automated detection and response across 10k+ endpoints.
Developing PoCs, reverse engineering advanced campaigns, and stress-testing platform mitigations like CET and CFG.
Building adversary emulation scenarios that validate controls from Active Directory abuse paths to cloud misconfigurations.

colophon: Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind.
Set in Space Grotesk, Inter, Newsreader, and JetBrains Mono.
No trackers, no analytics, no cookies.
